title: Industrial Property Act (Date of Commencement) Order, 2012
text:
Supplement C — Botswana Government Gazette dated 31st August, 2012 C.699
Statutory Instrument No. 69 of 2012
INDUSTRIAL PROPERTY ACT
(Act No. 8 of 2010)
INDUSTRIAL PROPERTY ACT (DATE OF COMMENCEMENT) ORDER, 2012
(Published on 31st August, 2012)
ARRANGEMENT OF PARAGRAPHS
PARAGRAPH
1.Citation
2.Commencement of Act No. 8 of 2010
IN EXERCISE of the powers conferred on the Minister of Trade and Industry by section 1
of the Industrial Property Act, 2010, the following Order is hereby made —
1. This Order may be cited as the Industrial Property Act (Date of Citation
Commencement) Order, 2012.
2. The 31st August, 2012 is hereby appointed as the date on which the Commencement
Industrial Property Act, 2010, shall come into operation — of Act No. 8 of
2010
MADE this 27th day of July, 2012.
DORCAS MAKGATO-MALESU,
Minister of Trade and Industry.
